entities.name: Nameless Angel
entities.description: Angel worshiped in the Approaches of Kessig who blessed them with the Seelenstone.

entities.name: Seelenstone
entities.description: Relic of the priory that stilled souls.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi Titan whose madness struck the angel.

entities.name: Rom
entities.description: Old hunter who killed the angel.

entities.name: Tacenda Verlasen
entities.description: Whom the angel's soul helped defeat her sister.

events.summary: The Nameless Angel grants the Approaches the Seelenstone.
events.quote: The Nameless Angel had granted the Approaches the boon of the Seelenstone

events.summary: Struck by Emrakul's madness, the Angel is locked away, then killed by Rom and nailed to a catacomb wall.
events.quote: She was killed by the old hunter Rom and nailed to a wall in the catacombs.

events.summary: The angel's soul speaks to Tacenda Verlasen and helps her defeat Willia.
events.quote: Her soul spoke to Tacenda Verlasen

relations.quote: She was killed by the old hunter Rom
Although she represented the Church of Avacyn
